scope: Every unbridged classic110 and stellar133 StatMod/AttackMod Amount callback in the named built sources, grouped only where source path and body SHA are identical.
inputs: docs/source-character-dynamic-coverage-20260928.json; built source roots and pinned source commits recorded per lane below.

classificationDefinitions.constant-initialization: All captured producer writes represented for this vector are numeric literals; lifecycle and callback gates still apply.
classificationDefinitions.talent-table-or-level-lookup: Callback or producer selects a talent-level table value; exact table producer and level source remain part of the formula.
classificationDefinitions.live-getter-arithmetic: Callback formula reads live/snapshot/stat getters and performs arithmetic; preserve gates and getter timing.
classificationDefinitions.mutable-field-vector: Callback returns a field-backed slice; producer/update lines are evidence, but runtime lifecycle/order is not established by static source scan.
classificationDefinitions.indexed-vector-selection: Callback returns a selected element of a table/vector; selection index and table writes require preservation.
classificationDefinitions.multi-slot-vector: Two or more distinct attributes.* slots are explicitly written to the returned vector in callback or producer evidence.
classificationDefinitions.only-nil-return: No vector expression is returned; side effects inside callback, if any, are recorded separately in raw callback source.
classificationDefinitions.no-auto-migration-claim: Classification supports implementation planning only; no automatic migration or runtime verification is asserted.
classificationDefinitions.cross-time-field-state-candidate: Field-backed vector returned by callback; source references indicate mutable field storage. This is a lifecycle candidate only, not proof of runtime timing.
classificationDefinitions.multi-slot-mixed: Two or more attribute slots have explicit producer writes; retain each slot expression independently.
classificationDefinitions.definitionCategories: Per-lane observed source patterns; overlapping labels are allowed and do not imply runtime verification.
